documentation.method: Read-only Markdown inline/reference/HTML path and GFM-style heading/line-anchor inspection. Fenced code is excluded. External URLs are recorded without access. Historical .md.original bytes use their explicit original-repository-context relocation map.

dependencies.method: Static inspection of root package scripts, declared/locked direct dependencies, literal imports and import.meta.url references using explicit publication-root file mappings. No project module or command was executed.
limitations: Dependencies were not installed and no fresh executable validation was performed.

Wrangler is not pinned as a project dependency; provider, dry-run and scheduled-handler validation remain pending.
The deployment validator's Python standard-library TOML support is an external runtime prerequisite.

The original project secret checker pins historical .env.example bytes. The approved comment-only derivative is separately validated and needs template-pin review before fresh project-checker qualification.

security.scope: Every publication file, including all original payload bytes, eight publication metadata files and checksum records, decoded as UTF-8 and additionally UTF-16LE when NUL bytes occur. Final serialization is followed by read-only checksum, path-set and security readback. No values are emitted.
